variants.name: Xác nhận thường
variants.spec: Normal confirmation. Badge gold gradient #FFD34D to #F2B807 with navy check mark. Eyebrow exact "XÁC NHẬN". Title exact "Thoát game". Body exact "Bạn muốn thoát Cờ Tỷ Phú?". Left cream button exact "Hủy". Right gold raised button exact "Thoát".
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit target: the provided Cờ Tỷ Phú lobby reference. Produce a high fidelity mobile modal concept over this lobby, as a PNG image for review only.
Preserve the reference lobby composition, mascot, Vietnamese logo and pixel cityscape behind the overlay. Darken the ENTIRE lobby evenly with a navy rgba(20,27,38,.62) scrim. The foreground dialog must remain bright. Do not redesign the lobby. No phone device frame, no mockup labels, no extra elements.
Framing: portrait, same ratio as 390 × 844 CSS pixels; output at roughly 2–3x pixel density.
Dialog anatomy is strict: horizontally and vertically centered card 340 CSS px wide; compact automatic height around 205–235 CSS px, NOT a giant tall popup. Cream paper #FCFDF0, navy #1F2A44 2px outline, radius 22px, padding18px, 14px vertical gaps, hard 6px dark bottom shadow plus soft shadow. No large decorative illustration, no mascot on dialog, no top-right X.
Heading LEFT aligned: a 42×42 rounded square icon badge (radius12, navy outline, navy icon22) at left; to the right, a small uppercase eyebrow at12px and a title at21px bold. Smooth rounded Nunito-like Vietnamese type, NOT pixel text. Body underneath in navy15px/1.45, left aligned. Buttons minimum48px tall, smooth pill, navy outline and raised bottom edge. Two buttons are equal width with gap10; one button spans full row. No other text inside dialog.
Match the reference warm gold/cream raised UI treatment; keep pixel art only on background.
